🌟 build123d | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating precise, parametric 2D and 3D CAD models programmatically using Python for manufacturing applications.
✨ Key Features: • Parametric 2D and 3D CAD modeling • Pythonic interface • Built on Open Cascade geometric kernel • Suitable for 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting • Operator-driven modeling for algebraic design
📖 Summary: Build123d is a Python framework for parametric 2D and 3D CAD modeling, built on the Open Cascade geometric kernel. It offers a Pythonic interface for creating precise models suitable for manufacturing processes like 3D printing and CNC machining.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 m3e-canvas | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Rapid prototyping and design of Material 3 Expressive mobile and desktop UIs, with the ability to generate prompts for AI-powered code generation.
✨ Key Features: • Drag-and-drop Material 3 Expressive UI components • Magnetic connections for grouping elements • Real Material 3 Expressive loading indicators • Support for phone and desktop screen sizes with responsive layout adjustments
📖 Summary: M3E Canvas is a browser-based design tool that allows users to visually sketch and prototype Material 3 Expressive UI screens. It enables linking screens, simulating tap-through navigation, and generating AI-friendly prompts for code generation.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 OpenBot | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a secure and auditable platform for deploying and managing AI agents that can perform real-world tasks within a user's own computing environment.
✨ Key Features: • AI agents with dedicated browsers, files, and tools • Action decision and recording via a central gateway • Runs on your own infrastructure (Docker Compose)
📖 Summary: OpenBot is an open-source platform for running AI agents, referred to as 'coworkers,' within your own infrastructure. It provides each agent with a dedicated browser, file access, and tools, all governed by a secure gateway that logs every action. This allows for trusted delegation of real work to AI agents.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 DevToys | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide developers with a single, efficient application containing a wide variety of essential utilities for common development tasks, reducing the need for multiple external tools or websites.
✨ Key Features: • Bundle of tiny tools for specific tasks
📖 Summary: DevToys is a comprehensive suite of developer tools designed to streamline daily tasks. It offers a wide array of utilities for converting, encoding/decoding, formatting, generating, and testing various data types, all within a user-friendly interface. The application also features smart detection to automatically select the appropriate tool for clipboard content and supports extensibility for custom tools.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
